ideas.title: FBI Surveillance of Left-Leaning Groups
ideas.description: Investigate the FBI's surveillance of left-leaning groups in Minnesota and the potential implications for civil liberties.
questions: What is the extent of the FBI's surveillance?
How does this impact civil liberties?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant government overreach and abuse of power. It is essential to investigate and report on this topic to ensure that the public is aware of the potential risks to their civil liberties.

ideas.title: Sex Trafficking in Anoka County
ideas.description: Investigate the sex trafficking organization operated by a former assistant Anoka County attorney and the prevalence of sex trafficking in the state.
questions: How prevalent is sex trafficking in Anoka County?
What actions are being taken to prevent sex trafficking?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant issues with sex trafficking in the state. It is essential to investigate and report on this topic to ensure that the public is aware of the risks and that law enforcement is taking adequate action to prevent sex trafficking.
